T: It's after midnight. Do you know where your dinner is?
D: A word processor's night out in SoHo spirals into one bizarre disaster after another.
P: Serve the bagels when Kiki shows off her bagel and cream cheese paperweights.
S: Bagel paperweight bites with chive schmear
Kiki's plaster bagel-and-cream-cheese paperweights, but edible

Toasted mini bagels piled with chive and black pepper cream cheese, smoked salmon and a sprinkle of everything seasoning. Halve 8 mini bagels and toast until golden. Beat 250g cream cheese with 2 tbsp milk, 3 tbsp snipped chives and plenty of black pepper. Pipe or spread thickly onto the bagels. Top with 150g smoked salmon, a few capers and everything bagel seasoning made from sesame, poppy seeds, garlic flakes and salt.
the angry mob chasing Paul in the ice cream truck

Vanilla soft serve in crisp cones, dipped in setting chocolate and rolled in crushed peanuts and rainbow sprinkles. Soften 1 litre vanilla ice cream for 10 minutes. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 40ml coconut oil and cool to room temperature. Pipe the ice cream into 8 cones with a large star nozzle and freeze for 20 minutes. Dip the tops into the chocolate, then straight into 50g crushed roasted peanuts or sprinkles. Freeze 5 minutes to set.
M: the bartender who owes Paul a favour
Thick hand-formed chuck patty, seasoned at the last moment, griddled to medium, cheddar, raw onion and pickles on a toasted bun.
Three toasted slices: roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut into triangles, chips on the side.
W: Vanilla butter cake covered in a thick, matte white seven-minute frosting (egg whites and sugar whisked over a bain-marie), roughly smoothed like plaster.
K: the bartender at the Terminal Bar, and Paul still can't get home

Bourbon shaken with lemon, sugar syrup and egg white until silky, served over ice with bitters and a cocktail cherry. Dissolve 50g caster sugar in 50ml hot water and cool. Shake 180ml bourbon, 90ml lemon juice, 60ml syrup and 1 egg white hard without ice for 15 seconds, then with ice for 15 seconds. Strain into 4 ice-filled rocks glasses. Add 2 drops aromatic bitters to each foam and a cocktail cherry.

m.note: Thick griddled chuck patty, cheddar, raw onion and pickles.
m.how: Hand-form 600g beef chuck mince into four thick patties without overworking. Heat a griddle over medium-high heat. Season with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp pepper just before cooking. Griddle for 5 to 6 minutes each side until cooked through, checking the centre reaches 75°C. Top with 80g cheddar in the last minute. Toast 4 burger buns cut-side down. Assemble with the patties, 1 thinly sliced raw onion and 80g sliced dill pickles.

w.note: Vanilla butter cake with thick matte white seven-minute frosting.
w.how: Heat the oven to 180°C conventional and line a 16cm cake tin. Beat 100g softened butter with 100g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla extract, then fold in 120g self-raising flour and 30ml milk. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until a skewer comes out clean; cool completely. For seven-minute frosting, whisk 2 egg whites, 120g caster sugar and 1 tbsp water in a heatproof bowl over gently simmering water for 7 minutes, until thick, glossy and hot throughout. Remove from the heat and whisk 2 minutes more until stiff. Cover the cake in a thick matte-looking layer, roughly smoothing it like plaster. Cut into four pieces.
